subject: Case Assignment
Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: These heuristics are a hard conflict when they share an affected activity.
contradictions.measured_said: Both candidates were applied and Phase-3 built the combined model despite sharing A_CANCELLED.
evidence: get_pair_relation found condition_fires=true with shared activity A_CANCELLED
Phase-3 outcome: built=true; CA-002 and NI-001 both applied successfully
contradictions.note: The hard incompatibility claim is false for this pair; their effects were confounded, but the model remained legal.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: The CA-002 assignment redesign materially worsened queueing and throughput, although other Case Assignment candidates helped.
evidence: CA-002 A_DECLINED waiting increased with z=51.29
CA-002 sole-owned throughput worsened by 1.0676 h/case with z=41.19
CA-001 improved throughput by 0.9445 h/case with z=-108.29 and CA-003 contributed to improvement
contradictions.note: The evidence is strongly heterogeneous rather than a clean refutation of the heuristic: pooled assignment can create contention, while focused assignment can help.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 coincided with materially worse waiting at O_CANCELLED, while its sole-owned throughput signal was insignificant.
evidence: O_CANCELLED waiting increased by 0.4125 h with z=5.39
NI-001 sole-owned throughput was insignificant with z=-0.28
contradictions.note: The effect is attributed rather than isolated and is confounded with shared activities and CA-002; retain the prior but record this contention counterexample.

subject: Activity Composition
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Composition has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: Both applied Activity Composition candidates improved throughput without measurable duration or resource changes.
evidence: AC-001 improved footprint-owned throughput by 0.9445 h/case with z=-108.29
AC-002 improved O_SENT throughput by 0.0228 h/case with z=-11.47
contradictions.note: The measured pattern is consistent with removing handover seams rather than changing service duration.

subject: Activity Elimination
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Elimination has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: Deleting W_Nabellen offertes materially improved throughput.
evidence: AE-002 produced a measured -2.778 h/case change with z=-96.24
contradictions.note: The observed throughput improvement supports the elimination prior.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CR-001 produced a significant simulated throughput improvement, with additional log evidence of removed repeat-contact waiting.
evidence: CR-001 solely owned a -0.0078 h/case improvement with z=-6.95
The log estimates 14.0442 hours saved per repeat occurrence
contradictions.note: The simulated and exogenous log evidence agree, but the exogenous estimate remains outside the simulation ranking.

subject: Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Specialization has a weak positive time impact through faster service.
contradictions.measured_said: SPC-001 improved waiting, duration, and throughput in the confirmation run.
evidence: SPC-001 waiting improved with z=-36.51
SPC-001 duration improved with z=-3.995
SPC-001 throughput improved by 0.4658 h/case with z=-44.39
contradictions.note: This confirms the predicted service-time and throughput direction for at least one isolated specialization.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weakly positive time impact because assigning one case to one resource reduces handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-002 significantly worsened waiting and sole-owned throughput, showing that case assignment can create queueing harm rather than a time gain.
evidence: CA-002 sole-owned throughput worsened by 1.0089 h/case (z=35.53)
Waiting on A_DECLINED rose significantly (z=48.29)
Phase-3 built CA-002 successfully
contradictions.note: The prior is too uniformly positive for time: assignment benefits are conditional on capacity and contention, although this round does not establish a universally negative effect.

subject: Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Specialization should improve service time, while its queueing effect must be measured rather than assumed.
contradictions.measured_said: SPC-003 improved waiting, duration, throughput, and resources; SPC-002's shared activity showed queueing contention, but its marginal effect was not separable.
evidence: SPC-003 throughput improved by 3.7986 h/case (z=-24.62)
SPC-003 waiting improved (z=-125.72) and duration improved (z=-26.01)
SPC-005/CBW-002 shared W_Valideren aanvraag waiting worsened (z=24.10), with SPC-002 remaining covered
contradictions.note: The measured evidence supports the service-time direction while confirming that queueing is context-dependent; no impact correction is warranted.
